diagnosis: PendingMessageAcknowledgmentView exposes stored system messages intended for user consumption. The endpoint fetches StoredUserMessage.objects.get(pk=message_id) without checking msg.recipient == request.user. An authenticated user can iterate through message IDs to read confidential system notices, security notifications, and private announcements belonging to other users.
